chancellor.name: pastor Shin Kishou
chancellor.message: Tokyo International Theological Seminary, responding to the calling God has given to the Japanese church in this era, has entered into MOUs with the Reformed General Assembly and the Capital International Graduate University to actively advance cooperative missions. This represents a union of faith aimed at restoring Japanese denominations and pastorless churches by raising pastors equipped with the Word, theology, and practical ministry. Standing on biblical Reformed theology, the seminary seeks to fulfill its mission of training pastors who give life to the church and ministers who restore ministry fields. Furthermore, it prepares missional leaders who proclaim the Gospel in a multiethnic and multicultural society, and declares its commitment to advance toward world evangelization in obedience to the Lord’s Great Commission to “make disciples of all nations.” Trusting that God Himself, who began this work, will also guide and bring it to completion, Tokyo International Theological Seminary will faithfully walk to the end as an instrument serving the Japanese church and all nations.

principal.name: Shin Timothy
principal.message:
Welcome to Tokyo International Theological Seminary.

The goal of this theological seminary is to train men and women through Christ-centered, biblically rooted, and mission-oriented theological education for the sake of Japan and world evangelization.

Japan presents both great opportunity and great challenge for Christian ministry. As one of the most influential yet spiritually underserved nations in the world, it calls for evangelists who are grounded in biblical truth, spiritual sensitivity, and mission-mindedness. This seminary was established in response to that need.

Our curriculum integrates biblical studies, theology, ministry practice, and spiritual formation within a Christ-centered learning community. Our faculty includes professors who have served in theological education through Sudo International University (SIS) and pastors from the Reformed Presbyterian Church of Korea (RPCK), bringing both academic excellence and pastoral experience into the classroom.

Whether you are considering pastoral ministry, cross-cultural mission, Christian education, or a deeper theological understanding, we invite you to consider joining our community.
